details: K-chunking of gate/up phase assigned; orienting on program descriptor + kernels

Step-1 as specified is INFEASIBLE: matmul_block has a hard static_assert forbidding in0_policy=NoWaitNoPop, AND the in0 index model is K-block-major (subblock stride = out_subblock_h*in0_block_k) while our resident x is m-major with row stride KR_PAD. Fix chosen: keep in0_block_k=KR_PAD (so subblock stride IS the row stride) and shift the K origin per K-block with a NEW In0BaseOffsetFn hook (mirror of In1BaseOffsetFn), appended AFTER Buf in the template list so zero existing callers change. Also gated the in0 wait/pop on the policy.

GU_KCHUNKS=1 baseline 131516 ns pcc 0.999457 (matches coordinator ground truth 129959, in band). GU_KCHUNKS=4 with the SHIPPED bfp8 cb_gate_acc -> pcc=nan maxrel=inf. Hypothesis: packer L1 accumulation is illegal on a BLOCK-FLOAT (bfp8) target; production matmul_op factory forces interm0=Float16_b whenever packer_l1_acc_en. Next: add a bf16 gu_interm region under the knob to confirm.

HARD L1 BLOCKER. With the mandatory bf16 accumulation region (n_gu_block=48 bf16 tiles = 98304 B) the program needs 1660608 B vs max 1572864 B. So the SHIPPED op already sits at 1562304 B = 99.3% of L1 with only 10560 B free -- the descriptor comments claiming ~121KB/~159KB free are STALE. Isolation plan: measure the lever with MOE_SWIGLU_DEPTH_X=1 (frees M_BLOCK*KR_PAD bfp8 = 243712 B and is PROVABLY free at count 256, a single M-block, where the second slot is allocated but never reserved), applied identically to baseline and candidate.

VERDICT REGRESSION. count 256, 88 cores, DEPTH_X=1 (provably free at 1 M-block), 2 samples each: shipped N=3/K=1 130924/129996; N=1/K=1 139184/139356 (+6.8% = the cost of FORFEITING N-chunking, which K-chunking forces); N=1/K=2+kpub 142494/143412 (+9.6% vs shipped, +2.6% vs its own N=1 baseline); N=1/K=4+kpub 143037. kc2 ~= kc4 so the cost is NOT the extra packs -- it is the forfeited N-chunking + gate/up interleave + the extra bf16->bfp8 copy. Per-K-sub-block publication (WG_KPUB) worth only -0.7%, in band. PCC IMPROVES (0.999671 vs 0.999457, maxrel halved 0.0288 vs 0.0512) because the bf16 accumulator removes a bfp8 quantisation step. Default path re-verified: golden 45/45, unit 124/125 (only the expected pre-existing test_perfexp_reader_head_scheduling).

MY EARLIER 10560 B FREE FIGURE WAS WRONG. Direct per-CB sum from create_program_descriptor at M_BLOCK=8/DEPTH_X=2/11x8: TOTAL 1450816 B, FREE 122048 B. The descriptor comment saying ~121KB free was RIGHT; my stale claim was wrong. The 1660608 B overflow I saw came from a --profile run (profiler L1 reservation ~111KB); the unprofiled figure is what ships. M_BLOCK=16 exact: needs 806272 B more than M_BLOCK=8 at DEPTH_X=1 (cb_x +243712, other M-scaled CBs +562560 -- more than the 415KB estimate because gather/slice/gate_silu also scale with M_BLOCK).

COORDINATOR IS RIGHT, I WAS WRONG TWICE. Free L1 = 10560 B. ATTRIBUTED the 111488 B gap precisely: program.cpp:1711 compares cb_region_end, which is an ADDRESS not a size -- CircularBufferAllocator::mark_address (program.cpp:1201) starts l1_regions at base_address = L1_UNRESERVED_BASE. So allocator number = 111488 + sum(CB sizes), and the CB budget is 1572864-111488 = 1461376. NOT the profiler: the base is charged unprofiled, which is why the coordinator saw the same offset without --profile. get_max_worker_l1_unreserved_size() (1532032) is a DIFFERENT quantity (buffer allocator region, not this program cb region), so the offset must be calibrated per program. Probe now self-checks the calibration against the observed 1562304.

FINAL RESOLUTION of the L1 disagreement: BOTH figures were right, for DIFFERENT GRIDS. 11x10 (110 cores, KR_PAD 23): CB sum 1339648, free 121728 -- the descriptor comment was never stale. 11x8 (88 cores, KR_PAD 28): CB sum 1450816, free 10560 -- correct for the grid the perf targets were set on. KR_PAD 23->28 inflates cb_x_tiles by 87040 B and each weight CB by 17280 B. LESSON: never state an L1 free-space figure without naming the grid. My L1_UNRESERVED_BASE=111488 attribution (cb_region_end is an ADDRESS, program.cpp:1201/1711) was right and is what made the grid-dependence visible. ALSO: my regression result invalidated the coordinator L1-is-the-blocker handover -- freeing 98 KB unlocks a MEASURED +9.4% regression, so the honest status is no positive-value lever identified, not L1-blocked.
